description_en: Queries the provisioned CIDR blocks of an IPAM pool
description_zh: 查询IPAM地址池预置的CIDR地址段
kebab_example: aliyun vpcipam list-ipam-pool-cidrs --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --ipam-pool-id ipam-pool-6rcq3tobayc20t0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListIpamPoolCidrs

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the region where the IPAM is created.

Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to obtain the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
IPAM托管地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the IPAM pool
parameters.name: ipam_pool_id

parameters.help_en:
The provisioned CIDR block to query.

Only IPv4 CIDR blocks are supported
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的预置CIDR地址段。

目前，只支持IPv4类型的地址段
parameters.name: cidr

parameters.help_en:
The token that is used to retrieve the next page of results. Set the value to the `NextToken` value that is returned in the last call. You do not need to specify this parameter for the first call.

If NextToken is empty, no further query is needed.

If NextToken has a value, use it as the token for the next query
parameters.help_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：
如果NextToken为空表示没有下一次查询。
如果NextToken有返回值，该取值表示下一次查询开始的令牌
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries to return on each page. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 分批次查询时返回的最多条目数。取值范围：1~100，默认值为10
parameters.name: max_results

Count.description_en: The number of entries returned on the current page
Count.description_zh: 分批次查询时返回的具体条目数

IpamPoolCidrs.description_en: A list of provisioned CIDR blocks of the IPAM pool
IpamPoolCidrs.description_zh: IPAM地址池预置的CIDR地址段列表

items.description_en: The details of a provisioned CIDR block
items.description_zh: IPAM地址池预置的CIDR地址段列表

IpamPoolId.description_en: The instance ID of the IPAM pool

Status.description_en:
The instance status of the provisioned CIDR block of the IPAM pool. Valid values:

Created: The CIDR block is created.

Deleted: The CIDR block is deleted
Status.description_zh:
IPAM地址池预置CIDR的实例状态。取值：

Created：表示创建完成。
Deleted：表示已删除

MaxResults.description_en: The maximum number of entries returned per page
MaxResults.description_zh: 分批次查询时返回的最多条目数。取值范围：1~100，默认值为10

NextToken.description_en:
The token that is used to retrieve the next page of results.

If this parameter is empty, no more results are to be returned.

If a value is returned, the value is the token that is used for the next query
NextToken.description_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：
如果NextToken为空表示没有下一次查询。
如果NextToken有返回值，该取值表示下一次查询开始的令牌

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries that match the query
